bosses.name: Yamaraja: Wind
bosses.strategy:
Note that Yamaraja: Wind is actually an EARTH class, so make sure not to
fuse into the Raging Tiger.
Its Shockwave attack will do decent damage to each character, while its
Flying Stones attack will do major damage, but to only one character.
However, its PHYSICAL attacks are the ones you have to worry about; it
can do a three hit attack that will easily kill a party member, even if
they're in the back row, so be sure to stay healed.
If you have the Tornado Fusion, have Yuri fuse into that; otherwise, have
him fuse into the Death Emperor. Use his Wind Shear/Dark Messenger Spells
continuously; if he runs out of MP, have either him or someone else
replenish it so he can keep dishing out the damage. Have Margarete on
healing duty, using Thera Leaves on whoever needs them, as well as using
Mana Leaves on Yuri and Zhuzhen to keep their MP up. Have Zhuzhen use his
Ogre Flamedance continuously, stopping to heal if someone needs it.
Yuri should be doing the most damage if he has the Tornado Fusion, so
keep his MP up while keeping everyone else healed.

notes.text: Make sure to remove any useful equipment from Alice, as she'll be temporarily leaving your party. Especially the Pedometer, if she has it.

The shop here sells both the Pirate and Brigand Earrings. The Pirate Earrings increase your chances of getting an item after a battle, while the Brigand Earrings increase the amount of money you receive after the battle. You may want to buy some Brigand Earrings and equip them now, they'll pay for themselves in no time! Make a note that the effect does stack for each party member that also is wearing them, so make sure to have the whole party wear some when you need to grind for some cash! These can only be bought in Asia, so make sure to get some when you have the extra cash.

The Seals you receive throughout the game increase certain statistics of the character it's used on. Normally, you only get the minimal increase if used outside of battle, but if you use it in battle, you have a chance of increasing it even more, so make sure to use them in battle.

The next boss not only is very difficult, but he is also an Earth class. By now, you should be very close to obtaining Yuri's level 1 Wind Fusion, Tornado. The Water Creepers in Dalian are a Wind class, so fight enough battles with them until you are able to go to the Graveyard to challenge Tornado. Also, make sure that you are at least level 10 before challenging the next boss, or you'll have a pretty rough time against him.   NOTE     Make sure to remove any useful equipment from Alice, as she'll be
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   temporarily leaving your party. Especially the Pedometer, if she has
           it.

When you gain control here in Dalian, head left and up the dock here to find a
chest containing a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Don't worry about the man guarding the
pen; we'll come back to him in a moment. Follow the path as it turns west, but
before going to the next screen, go up into the area that is partially fenced
in, and look between the two wooden structures near the edge of the screen to
find a [_TALISMANOFLUCK_]. Once you have it, go to the next area.

Use the Save Point here to Save, then go back to the previous area and talk to
the Man with Turtle. He's lost his turtle, and would like help finding it.

——————————————————————————————————————————
   [1] That's too bad.
   [2] I'll help if we trade something.
——————————————————————————————————————————

Choose option 2 to help him out. The turtle hides in a random place, so just
run around and press the CROSS button repeatedly until you find it. These are
the prizes you receive depending on how many tries it took you to find the
turtle:

 - 1-2 Attempts yield a [_LOTTERY TICKET_].
 - 3-4 Attempts yield a [_TALISMANOFLUCK_].
 - 5-6 Attempts yield a [_TENT_].
 - 7-8 Attempts yield a [_THERA LEAF_].

If you're not successful at getting a Lottery Ticket, just reload and try
again. He also says that if you come here again tomorrow, something good will
happen, so don't forget! Once you have your prize, head back to the center of
town. Go into the building on the upper-right, which is the Sea Turtle
Restaurant. Feel free to do some shopping here; I'd make sure you have plenty
of Thera, Mana, and Pure Leaves, and I'd upgrade your three Leather Belts to
Casual Belts and your three Bandannas for Leather Caps. While you're in here,
look behind the back table near the serving window to find a chest containing a
[_SILVER HOURGLASS_]. Head back out into the center of town.

  NOTE     The shop here sells both the Pirate and Brigand Earrings. The
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Pirate Earrings increase your chances of getting an item after a
           battle, while the Brigand Earrings increase the amount of money you
           receive after the battle. You may want to buy some Brigand Earrings
           and equip them now, they'll pay for themselves in no time! Make a
           note that the effect does stack for each party member that also is
           wearing them, so make sure to have the whole party wear some when
           you need to grind for some cash! These can only be bought in Asia,
           so make sure to get some when you have the extra cash.

To your right you should see an old man standing underneath a wooden structure.
Search just his lower-right for a chest containing a [_TEAOFTHEHEALER_]. That's
it for items out here, so enter the building to the upper-left, which is the
Inn, for a scene. Once you regain control, head downstairs to visit the weapon
and armor shop. Before talking to the shopkeeper, follow the hallway to the
upper-right corner and examine the ground here to find a [_SEAL OF AURA_].

  NOTE     The Seals you receive throughout the game increase certain
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   statistics of the character it's used on. Normally, you only get the
           minimal increase if used outside of battle, but if you use it in
           battle, you have a chance of increasing it even more, so make sure
           to use them in battle.

You can't get the chest inside the shop yet, so go ahead and talk to the
shopkeeper if you want to buy something. Nothing is really needed at the
moment, so go ahead and head back up to the first floor. The people here are
now gone, so examine the boxes in the upper-left corner of the bedroom for a
[_TENT_]. Leave the Inn to see that the atmosphere has changed. Save your game,
and make sure once again that Alice has everything removed from her.

Take a few steps southeast to start a very long (and... odd) series of events
where Alice will temporarily leave your party, and Zhuzhen will rejoin! Note
that there are now monsters outside, and take the opportunity to visit both
shops here in town to upgrade Zhuzhen's equipment, as well as to stock up on
Thera and Mana Leaves if you didn't earlier, since your primary healer is
temporarily out of commission. 15+ Thera Leaves should cover it.

  NOTE     The next boss not only is very difficult, but he is also an Earth
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   class. By now, you should be very close to obtaining Yuri's level 1
           Wind Fusion, Tornado. The Water Creepers in Dalian are a Wind class,
           so fight enough battles with them until you are able to go to the
           Graveyard to challenge Tornado. Also, make sure that you are at
           least level 10 before challenging the next boss, or you'll have a
           pretty rough time against him.

  NOTE     You may also want to take the time to fight more of the Frog Gods to
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   build up your points for your Light Fusion. They come in groups of
           three, so it wouldn't take very long, and I recommend doing it. Just
           be careful not to get paralyzed.

Before doing anything else, PUT EVERYONE IN THE BACK ROW! Physical attacks are
useless against the next boss, so we might as well keep ourselves a little more
protected. When you're ready, make your way back to the screen with the dock
and the pen with the turtle. Head inside the pen and search the left side to
find a [_R.PHOENIX TALON_]. Once you have that, make your way to the dock and
examine the red sphere here to take on the next boss.

  NOTE     Remove all equipment from both Margarete and Zhuzhen after the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   battle, as they will both be temporarily unavailable for battle in
           the next few events.

After the battle, make your way back to the Sea Turtle Restaurant to check on
Alice. After another long series of events, Alice will rejoin your party, and
you'll rest for the evening. When you regain control the next morning, make
your way back down to the basement of the Inn and take the path all the way
around into the equipment shop, where the little kid will finally let you have
his treasure, so open the chest here for a [_FLARE BROOCH_] for Yuri. Always
make sure he has this equipped; it reduces the amount of SP needed for his
Fusion!

Head outside, then go down and talk to the lady drying her fish. She'll give
you a [_SALT-DRIED FISH_] to give to Sea Mother. SAVE YOUR GAME, then go into
the Sea Turtle Restaurant and talk to her; she'll accept the fish and tell you,
"Where the turtle looks, take three steps." and you'll find a stash of money.
Leave the restaurant, then take, actually, about two and a half steps to the
lower-left to find the stash. To get all of the money here, you must hit all
three areas of the Ring.

 - Hitting one area will net you [_500 CASH_].
 - Hitting two areas will net you [_1000 CASH_]
 - Hitting all three areas will net you [_2000 CASH_].

If you don't get 2000, reload and try again. Once you're done here, go back
into the restaurant and talk to the man in green, Filthy Samo. He'll reveal
himself as Lottery Member No. 14!

Make sure to win the Pocket Watch before continuing on; it gives the wearer
resistance to Judgment Ring anomalies in battle. If you don't win it, reload
your last save and try again. Remember, you need to win something from each
member at least once!

Save your game once again, then head over to the area with the dock and pen
once again. If you talk to the Man with Turtle once again, he'll offer to let
you play in his leaf field for 300 cash. You just have to take his hoe and dig
up three spots in the field, and anything you find becomes yours. With each dig
though, you'll have to complete a Normal Ring. Just like searching for the
turtle before, you can win prizes! They're not set like the previous game;
prizes include...

 - A Thera Leaf
 - A Mana Leaf
 - A Pure Leaf
 - A [_THIRD KEY_]!

The Third Key is worth getting, as it'll let you circle the Judgment Ring three
times in battle for a potential nine hits! There is only one here in the leaf
field, so once you find it, you won't find it again. Try to get it within the
first two times of playing the game, and if you don't get it, reload and try
again. If its battle effect has no interest to you, feel free to sell it for a
WHOPPING 15,000 cash! With a 5% price rise, you can sell it for 15,750! I think
you should sell it, to be quite honest!

There's also the Silent Peddler on the way to the dock. You can trade in some
of your steps for prizes if you want to, but I recommend saving them up until
you can get the best prize first, which happens to be someone's best armor at
10,000 steps.

That's it for Dalian, so on to our next destination! Go to the dock and talk to
the Courier Subordinate beside Margarete, who'll ask you if you're ready to go.
——————————————————————————————
   [1] No, not yet.
   [2] Yes, let's push off.
——————————————————————————————

Choose 2 to take off!
